verdict.rationale: Auth0 docs explicitly describe brute-force/bot protection (blocking IPs after consecutive failed logins to avoid DDoS), breached-password detection using a compromised-credentials database to stop credential stuffing/account takeover, and adaptive/risk-based MFA that steps up authentication on suspicious logins — directly matching the security-engineer's ask. These are first-party documented, product-level security features rather than third-party bolt-ons.  missing for 10: independent/hands-on validation (e.g., pen-test or analyst report) confirming real-world efficacy of these anti-bot/brute-force controls, since only vendor docs are cited.
